courses.synopsis: Introduction, system engineering applied to the design of industrial business system and organization. Industrial organization. Operation subsystem design, production planning and control, purchasing. Motion and time study. Factory planning and materials handling. Industrial standardization. Tool and manufacturing engineering. Industrial statistics. Inspection and quality control. The attitudes of organized labour towards industrial engineering methods.
